# Nick Castro

> Nick Castro is a Chicago-area builder who turns ideas into live websites and web tools, fast. He builds websites for local businesses, free web apps, interactive AI lessons for kids, and a children's book about machine learning, and is open to new projects or a role on a team.

## Projects
- [The Other Data](https://theotherdata.com/): Free alternative-data stock tool. Look up a ticker for plain-English AI summaries of news and quotes, plus offbeat indirect signals most people miss — unusual correlations that can hint at where a stock is headed, built for insight rather than candlestick charts.
- [Does AI Know My Business? (AI Visibility Check)](https://doesaiknowmybusiness.com/): Free tool that shows whether AI recommends a local business. An AI agent runs live Google searches, then gives a 0–100 score, the competitors AI names instead, a website check, and a fix plan with ready-to-paste schema code. English and Spanish.
- [SiteSafeCheck](https://sitesafecheck.com/): Free, passive website security check for small businesses. Enter a site and get a plain-English grade on HTTPS, security headers, email spoofing protection (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), info leaks, and cookie safety, with AI explaining each issue and how to fix it.
- [How AI Works for Kids](https://howaiworksforkids.com/): Interactive lessons where kids ages 6–10 learn how AI works by teaching a tiny AI named Pip. 7 lessons, each with a read-aloud picture story, a hands-on game (including a real nearest-neighbor classifier and a next-word model that co-writes a story), a quick check, and a badge, plus a printable certificate. Kid-safe: no ads, accounts, chatbot, or kid data (COPPA-friendly). Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Vercel.
- [A&A Professional Roofers](https://www.aaproroofers.com/): Business website for A&A Professional Roofers LLC, a Chicago-area roofing company (services, gallery, service areas, free-quote form, Spanish-speaking callout).
- [Roblox Idea Generator](https://robloxideas.com/): Free Roblox game idea generator for developers: each idea comes with a core loop, a monetization plan with suggested Robux prices, a retention hook, a scope estimate, and a free one-page design doc.
- [The Smart Soccer Ball Mystery: Machine Learning for Kids – Book 1](https://nickcastrobuilds.com/book/): 24-page picture book for ages 6–10, co-written with Nancy Castro, that teaches how AI learns from data. Signed paperback ($14.99) and hardcover ($19.99) available direct from the authors; also on [Amazon](https://a.co/d/09uH5j59) (paperback $14.99, Kindle $4.99 / free on Kindle Unlimited). Paperback ISBN 979-8-252610-07-8; hardcover ISBN 979-8-1828-7871-5 (coming soon through bookstores and libraries).
- [AI Tools Pulse](https://open.spotify.com/show/2nHucl9A86Ingv3WVtQIh2): Short daily podcast about new AI tools.
